notation: Each case is a DSL snippet (`src`) run on a fresh Builder for gfx1201, with `b` the Builder, `V`, `S` its files and every name of the language imported. `built` is the stream the Builder made, before any pass: one line per instruction, `<form name> <operands> {fields}; <attributes>`. A register operand is written as VReg repr (`<file>:<value name>[<index in group>]x<dwords>` and `+<lo>` when lo != 0); a named register by its name; an immediate as its value, with the writer's spelling in quotes when it has one (`16'0x10'`); a block as `@label`. Source modifiers are written `-x`, `|x|`. Fields are in stored order. Attributes in a fixed order: comment, tag, abl, alias_ok, staged, wait_uses, in_region, places, published, lds=(region, what, field, offset: none or var, ordered), m0_set, waves_taken, fence. `values` lists the program's values in id order: `id file name n= align= [index=] [pin=] [same_as=]`. `records` holds the Program's lane regions and loops, the deferred records' kinds, each file's entered / pinned groups and lanes-covered names, and the wave index. `error` is the refusal (exception class and message) raised while the snippet ran. `render` (the whole pipeline's output) is the final.s; `render_error` a refusal of the pipeline's passes.

cases.name: nested_skip_region
cases.src:
col, val = V.u32(name="col", at=2), V.u32(name="val", at=3)

with b.lanes(col >= 8):
    val -= 1
    with b.lanes(val == 0, skip=True):
        val[...] = col + 1

v_add_nc_u32 v:val#1[0]x1, 1, v:col#1[0]x1 ; comment="val = col + 1" in_region=2
